registration.protocol: Economy uses first30 root accounts per style with unchanged A5 public-command policy, style budgets1/2/6routes and15/60/60service minutes. Route seed=root+day*7919+route*71; paid pull seed=root+day*9349+totalPulls*97; first invitation seed=root. These deterministic streams derive from the registered master seed, and are disclosed separately from the500 direct combat-seed cells. Day7 consumes the new earned saves; same root+7*7919 then+1 retry; no currency/level injection. Editions use all500 direct seeds, local simulation only.

limitations: Public-command progression proxy; registered master seeds, not a human playtest or elapsed seven days.
Tests the next uncleared chapter at the existing lowest-cat challenge band on arrival day7. Accounts already clear throughchapter3 replaychapter3.
A loss before reaching the boss counts as a failure. One informed retry is allowed separately from the economy daily route budget.
No advice means no informed retry success; paired no-advice run is diagnostic only.
